full_name: [full expansion to be provided by authors]
definition_rule: BMKMPHI is the single formal model name and is defined at first use with its full expansion; the acronym is then used consistently throughout

core_block.definition: one forward and one reverse Mamba2 layer applied to the spatial tokens, with their outputs summed
core_block.note: the code class name NdMamba2_2d may remain in source files, but the prose always says 'bidirectional Mamba2 block' or, after first use, 'the Mamba2 block'

consistency_rules: use BMKMPHI for the method as a whole, never Nd-Mamba2 as the model name
use 'bidirectional Mamba2 block' for the architectural component, never alternate spellings
define every acronym at first occurrence
keep the same spelling in tables, figures, captions and body text
